title: public-repo guard: do not flag sha256 digests in .ticfac/ run records as account ids
description: Found by CI on PR #80: the public-repo "Guard tracked files" job flags 32-hex-character values in .ticfac/runs/gate-cia-2/{attempts,checkpoint,decisions,evidence}/*.json as [account] identifiers (e.g. checkpoint.json:48 profile_digest "sha256:ccc33c86...", attempts/4.json:34 context_manifest_digest "0cf644d6...48d1"). These are content digests written by ticfac (contracts/ticfac-run-state.json), not Cloudflare account ids. Teach the guard to skip a 32-hex value that is prefixed by "sha256:" or sits in a JSON field whose name ends in _digest, or exempt .ticfac/runs/**/*.json from the account-id pattern while keeping every other rule (tokens, emails, hostnames) active on those files. Add a fixture case for a .ticfac record with digests (must pass) and one with a real-looking account id outside a digest field (must still fail). Find the guard: grep -rn "Guard tracked files" .github/workflows and the script it runs.
acceptance_criteria: The guard passes on the current .ticfac/runs/gate-cia-2 records and still fails on an account id or token placed in any tracked file; PR #80 public-repo check green
